title: European Supervisory Authorities (ESAs)
description: The three European Supervisory Authorities for financial regulation: EBA, EIOPA, and ESMA

authorities.name: European Banking Authority
authorities.address: Tour Europlaza, 20 Avenue Andre Prothin, 92927 Paris La Defense
authorities.mandate: Ensure effective and consistent regulation and supervision across the European banking sector. Maintain financial stability and safeguard the integrity, efficiency and orderly functioning of the banking sector.

board_of_supervisors.composition: Chairperson + heads of banking supervisory authorities from all EU Member States
board_of_supervisors.voting: Simple majority for most decisions; qualified majority for technical standards

management_board.composition: Chairperson + 6 members elected from Board of Supervisors + Executive Director (non-voting)

key_units.unit: Directorate I -- Banking Markets, Innovation and Products
key_units.function: Payment services, electronic money, crypto-assets (MiCA), FinTech, consumer protection
key_units.relevance_mica_dora: Primary unit for MiCA implementation and crypto-asset supervision

key_units.unit: Directorate II -- Prudential Regulation and Supervisory Policy
key_units.function: CRD/CRR implementation, own funds, large exposures, leverage ratio, liquidity
key_units.relevance_mica_dora: Own funds requirements for CASPs and token issuers

key_units.unit: Directorate III -- Banking Supervision and Resolution
key_units.function: Supervisory convergence, peer reviews, colleges, stress testing, resolution
key_units.relevance_mica_dora: Supervisory convergence tools for MiCA supervision across NCAs

key_units.function: DORA implementation, ICT risk, CTPP oversight framework
key_units.relevance_mica_dora: Lead unit for DORA CTPP designation and oversight

key_units.function: Anti-money laundering guidance, risk assessments, supervisory expectations
key_units.relevance_mica_dora: AML/CFT requirements for CASPs under MiCA

joint_bodies.name: Joint Committee of the ESAs
joint_bodies.role: Cross-sectoral coordination, consumer protection, AML, financial conglomerates
joint_bodies.eba_role: Rotating chair (shared with EIOPA and ESMA)

joint_bodies.name: Joint Oversight Venture (JOV)
joint_bodies.role: Coordinated oversight of CTPPs serving entities across banking, insurance, and securities

authorities.name: European Insurance and Occupational Pensions Authority
authorities.mandate: Protect policyholders, pension scheme members and beneficiaries. Promote sound regulation of insurance and occupational pensions across the EU. Contribute to systemic stability of the financial system.

board_of_supervisors.composition: Chairperson + heads of insurance and pensions supervisory authorities from all EU Member States
board_of_supervisors.voting: Simple majority for most decisions; qualified majority for technical standards

management_board.composition: Chairperson + 6 members elected from Board of Supervisors + Executive Director (non-voting)

key_units.function: Solvency II implementation, supervisory convergence, peer reviews, colleges
key_units.relevance_mica_dora: DORA implementation for insurance and pensions sector

key_units.function: Technical standards, IORPs directive, Solvency II review, sustainable finance
key_units.relevance_mica_dora: Regulatory technical standards for DORA in insurance

key_units.function: DORA oversight for insurance sector, ICT risk assessment

authorities.name: European Securities and Markets Authority
authorities.mandate: Enhance investor protection and promote stable and orderly financial markets. Direct supervision of credit rating agencies and trade repositories. Supervisory convergence across EU securities regulators.

board_of_supervisors.composition: Chairperson + heads of securities supervisory authorities from all EU Member States
board_of_supervisors.voting: Simple majority for most decisions; qualified majority for technical standards

management_board.composition: Chairperson + 6 members elected from Board of Supervisors + Executive Director (non-voting)

key_units.function: MiFID II/MiFIR, DLT pilot regime, crypto-asset trading platforms under MiCA
key_units.relevance_mica_dora: MiCA CASP supervisory convergence; DLT market infrastructure

key_units.function: Data reporting, EMIR trade repository supervision, MiCA registers
key_units.relevance_mica_dora: MiCA registers (CASPs, white papers); DORA incident reporting

key_units.function: Investor protection, prospectus regulation, MiCA white paper requirements
key_units.relevance_mica_dora: MiCA crypto-asset white paper review and guidance

key_units.function: Direct supervision of CRAs, trade repositories; benchmarks supervision
key_units.relevance_mica_dora: Supervisory experience applied to DORA oversight

joint_committee.name: Joint Committee of the European Supervisory Authorities
joint_committee.composition: Chairs of EBA, EIOPA, ESMA + their Executive Directors

sub_committees.name: Sub-Committee on Consumer Protection and Financial Innovation
sub_committees.focus: FinTech, consumer trends, complaints, cross-sectoral products

sub_committees.name: Sub-Committee on AML/CFT
sub_committees.focus: Anti-money laundering coordination (until AMLA becomes operational in 2025-2026)

sub_committees.name: Sub-Committee on Risk
sub_committees.focus: Cross-sectoral risk analysis, Joint Risk Report, systemic risk monitoring

sub_committees.name: Sub-Committee on Securitisation
sub_committees.focus: STS securitisation, reporting, due diligence requirements

outputs: Joint Committee Report on Risks and Vulnerabilities
Cross-sectoral guidelines (e.g. complaints handling, product governance)
